question: Should the exact staged first tutorial batch be executed locally: QE 7.5 silicon SCF followed by bands mode and bands.x, plus one ABINIT 10.8.3 invocation of the 21-dataset basic1 stage-2 H2 bond-distance scan?

options.summary: Authorize the exact two-calculator tutorial batch.
options.consequence: Run the three QE stages and one ABINIT invocation exactly once in their staged isolated external workspaces, stop dependent stages after a failure, retain separate streams and native outputs externally, and process useful energies, forces, bands, NetCDF/QEXSD content, warnings, and continuation relationships.
Retain the exact dry-run staging and preflight only; run no scientific executable.

recommendation: A — this is the smallest batch that begins both calculator campaigns while exposing QE inter-executable continuation and ABINIT within-invocation multidataset continuation.
blocked_scope: Any QE or ABINIT scientific executable invocation in this batch, retries, later tutorial stages, plotting, setting changes, production use, or cross-backend numerical comparison.
safe_scope: Read-only source inspection, exact external staging, identity checks, resource estimation, repository preflight documentation, and deterministic validation that does not invoke a scientific executable.
human_response: no this wrong, abinit and qe should be running the same simulation so that we can later extract the generic
authorized_scope: Do not execute the mismatched QE silicon-bands and ABINIT H2-distance-scan batch. Retain its preflight and external staging only. Redesign the next candidate so ABINIT and Quantum ESPRESSO run the same physical system and computational workflow before requesting a new exact protected-execution decision.
